entities.summary: The British Factory House, also known as the British Association House, is an 18th-century Neo-Palladian building located in the northern Portuguese centre of Porto, associated with the influence of Britain in the port wine industry. Factory House is a cultural heritage from Europe. Classified as Tier C (Archaeological) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
